blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multi-object tracking in sports broadcasts is hard for two reasons: athletes move fast and change direction abruptly, and the camera pans and zooms at the same time. We present ARC-SORT (Adaptive, Robust, Compensated SORT), a tracking-by-detection tracker that trains nothing and runs in real time. Its design rule: the tracker measures its own uncertainty, and that measurement decides how it acts. An Interacting Multiple Model (IMM) Kalman filter gives every track a predictive covariance, and we turn it into a per-track search region: the less reliable the motion prediction, the larger the region in which a detection may match (uncertainty-adaptive Expansion IoU, EIoU). On identical inputs, this continuous coupling is what matters: the same covariance used as a hard Mahalanobis gate hurts at every threshold we swept, and richer covariance summaries add nothing measurable. When two tracks cross, the assignment cost itself reports whether the decision was close. ARC-SORT keeps such pairs under review and applies at most one corrective identity swap once post-crossing appearance evidence shows the first decision was wrong; this adds +1.0 HOTA (higher order tracking accuracy) on both the SportsMOT and DanceTrack test sets at under a millisecond per frame. For players who leave the frame for seconds, motion extrapolation carries no information, so our offline re-identification drops the usual motion gate and links tracklets by appearance alone. ARC-SORT reaches 81.82 HOTA on the SportsMOT test set with the fewest identity switches of the 69 leaderboard entries as of August 2026 and tied-third multi-object tracking accuracy (MOTA, 97.09), and 62.1 HOTA on DanceTrack test with the same association settings. On Deep-EIoU's public detections and embeddings it reaches 80.31 HOTA, +3.1 over Deep-EIoU. It runs at about 50 frames per second on a laptop RTX 3060 GPU. Code will be released.
blocks.zh: 体育广播中的多对象跟踪由于两个原因很难进行:运动员动作快而突然改变方向,相机平板和缩放同时进行. 我们介绍ARC-SORT(英语:Adaptive, Robust, Confensated SORT),是一款逐一检测的跟踪跟踪器,不进行实时的训练并运行. 其设计规则: 追踪者测量自己的不确定性,测量决定它如何行动. 交互多模型(IMM)卡尔曼滤波器使每个轨道都具有预测共变性,我们把它变成每道搜索区域:运动预测越不可靠,检测可能匹配的区域越大(不确定-可适应扩展IoU,EIoU). 在相同的输入上,这种连续的接合是最重要的:同样的共变作为坚硬的马哈拉诺比斯门在我们所扫过的每一个阈值上都会受伤,而更丰富的共变总结则没有增加任何可测量的. 当两个轨道交叉时,任务本身就报告决定是否接近。 ARC-SORT不断审查这些配对,一旦交叉后的外观证据显示第一个决定是错误的,最多一次更正身份交换;这增加了SportsMOT和DanceTrack测试机的+1.0 HOTA(更高订单跟踪精度),每帧在一毫秒下。 对于离开帧数秒的玩家,运动外推带没有信息,因此我们离线的再识别会单独将通常的运动门降下并链接出轨迹. 截止2026年8月,ARC-SORT在SportsMOT测试装置上达到了81.82 HOTA,其中69个领跑板条目中身份开关最少,并有捆绑-第三多对象跟踪精度(MOTA,97.09),62.1 HOTA在DanceTrack测试上达到了相同的关联设置. 在Deep-EIoU的公测上并嵌入到80.31 HOTA,+3.1在Deep-EIoU上方. 它运行在一台笔记本电脑RTX 3060 GPU上,每秒约50帧. 代码将发布。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Tracking-by-detection splits multi-object tracking (MOT) into two
steps: a detector finds object boxes in every frame, and an
association step links those boxes across frames into tracks that
keep their identities. The SORT family [ 7 ] performs the second step with a Kalman filter, which predicts where
each track will be, and a matching cost, usually the intersection
over union (IoU) between predicted and detected boxes, solved as a
linear assignment. This paper is about the association step only:
ARC-SORT takes the output of a fixed detector and trains nothing.

blocks.en:
Sports broadcasts concentrate the two failure modes of the SORT
paradigm into one domain: athletes sprint,
cut, and collide, violating the Kalman filter’s constant-velocity
assumption, while the broadcast camera pans and zooms on top. The dominant response is to make association more tolerant ,
enlarging boxes by a fixed margin [ 43 ] ,
schedule [ 21 ] , or velocity
heuristic [ 40 ] , or else to learn motion
per domain [ 27 , 22 , 2 ] . Meanwhile, two quantities that report how much the tracker should
trust itself are computed every frame and discarded: the filter’s
predictive covariance says how far the motion prediction can be
trusted, yet overlap-cost pipelines either ignore it at association
time or consume it as a hard Mahalanobis veto [ 42 ] (ground-plane costs [ 45 ] abandon overlap entirely);
and the assignment’s own cost margin says how nearly it preferred the
swapped pairing, yet nothing in the tracker’s state distinguishes a
confident match from a coin flip.

This paper is built on a single principle: a tracker should
let its own uncertainty govern its own decisions. We instantiate it
twice, as search breadth and commitment firmness, and follow it to
its limit. At short horizons the motion covariance acts as tolerance , not veto: our uncertainty-adaptive
Expansion IoU dilates each track’s matching region by a continuous
function of its predictive standard deviation, supplied by an
Interacting Multiple Model (IMM)
filter [ 8 , 5 ] . At
crossings, the assignment margin governs identity commitment :
a pair whose swap would cost the assignment almost nothing was

out-of-view gap (football’s dominant failure; median camera exit
111 frames) the covariance has diverged and a search region wider
than the frame is no gate at all, so the offline re-identification
stage drops the motion gate and lets appearance alone link
tracklets.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
SORT [ 7 ] established the predict–associate loop;
successive work strengthened every stage: appearance and post-hoc
refinement [ 42 , 12 ] ,
low-confidence recovery [ 47 ] ,
observation-centric drift correction [ 9 ] , camera
compensation [ 4 ] , ground-plane
modeling [ 45 ] , adaptive appearance
fusion [ 28 ] , weak
cues [ 44 ] , and track-centric
assignment [ 34 ] . Across this family, the filter’s
predictive covariance is either ignored at association time or, in
practice, consumed solely as a hard Mahalanobis
gate [ 42 ] ; the association cost itself is
uncertainty-blind, and the assignment is commitment-blind :
every match is final the frame it is made.

velocity threshold atop a trained long short-term memory (LSTM)

discretely switched; none derives it from the filter’s own predictive
covariance. Ours is a continuous function of that covariance, wide
exactly when the prediction is unreliable, and requires no
training.

blocks.en:
We presented ARC-SORT, a training-free tracker in which the
tracker’s own uncertainty governs its decisions: the IMM covariance
sets a continuous per-track association tolerance, the assignment’s
permutation margin defers near-ambiguous commitments until evidence
settles them, and where motion information has run out an
appearance-only merge replaces the motion-gated one.
